args.title: Export reports as TSV format
args.body: Issue 4202 requests the addition of the TSV format for exporting reports in the src/Report.ts file. This change is necessary because our warehouse loader only accepts tab-delimited files, and currently, the reports are exported only in CSV format. By adding TSV exporting functionality, we can avoid manual conversion, which often leads to errors, especially when transaction descriptions contain commas. The proposed change will enhance the report export feature to include TSV alongside the existing formats.
